Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 9

“...and while speaking, releasing, grasping, and opening and closing the eyes — holding firmly that it is the senses that move among the objects of sense.”

The list continues down to blinking. The insight is not that nothing happens but that the happening belongs to the machinery, with no one standing behind it claiming credit.
